recovery.description: These are the issues found at the time. Your source subtitles are saved. Viewing this report does not restart translation.

recovery.selection_unavailable: Some collections were deleted, archived or translate a different direction. Remove them and check again.

tour.collections_content: Collections group materials by work, streamer or topic, each with one translation direction.
tour.collections_hint: Switch collections on the left; the search box looks across all of them.
tour.entries_content: Type a source and its translation in the last row and press Enter; it is saved and in use. Requirements and background go under Notes.
tour.entries_hint: Required terms are always applied; preferred ones when they fit.
tour.studio_content: In Subtitle Studio, tick the collections to use in the translation settings, or pick a preset.
tour.studio_hint: Only ticked collections take part; disabled entries are skipped, and a term applies only when its source appears.
